part.text:
The fix is complete and validated. Summary of changes:

**`lib/adapters/http.js`** — Replaced the broken `looksLikeFormData` detection block in `prepareHttpAdapterRequest` with upstream-style handling:
- Spec-compliant `FormData` (Node.js 18 global, `formdata-node`) is detected via `utils.isSpecCompliantForm` and serialized to a multipart stream with `formDataToStream`, which computes the boundary `Content-Type` and `Content-Length` (preserving a user-supplied boundary).
- Legacy `form-data` package instances are handled via `getHeaders()` as before.

**`lib/utils.js`** — Added `isSpecCompliantForm` (checks `append`, `Symbol.toStringTag === 'FormData'`, and iterator) and exported it.

**`lib/helpers/formDataToStream.js` + `lib/helpers/readBlob.js`** — New helpers that encode spec-compliant FormData into a multipart `Readable` stream.

**`lib/platform/node/index.js`** — Added `ALPHABET` and `generateString` (crypto-based random boundary generation).

Validation:
- `test/unit/adapters/http.js` "SpecCompliant FormData › should allow passing FormData" (the FAIL_TO_PASS case) now passes.
- Full mocha suite: 139 passing / 3 failing with the fix, vs 138 passing / 4 failing at baseline — the same 3 pre-existing failures remain (`HTTPS protocol` timeout, `Blob`, flaky `max content length`, all failing at baseline too), and the issue's exact repro now sends a properly-encoded multipart body.
